subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la magnets-oda properties, magnetic/non-magnetic materials, poles, compass, attraction matrum repulsion-ai activities moolama paappom. Magnet-ai safe-aa use panni direction eppadi kandupidikkalaam-nu purinjukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Magnet attract pannura materials-ai identify panna mudiyum.
Magnet-oda poles enga irukku-nu describe panna mudiyum.
Freely suspended magnet north-south direction-la yen rest aagudhu-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Compass eppadi direction kaattudhu-nu solla mudiyum.
Like poles repel, unlike poles attract-nu demonstrate panna mudiyum.
Magnet use aagura daily-life situations-ai identify panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Magnets namma daily life-la
teaching_sequence.caption: Magnet sila objects-ai attract pannum; ellaa materials-aiyum attract pannaadhu. Iron objects magnet-kitta varumbodhu attract aagum. Fridge magnet, bag clip, compass madhiri examples-la magnets use aagudhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru magnet-ai paper clip, wooden stick, plastic ruler, iron nail pakkathula kondu poi observe pannunga. Edhu attract aagudhu, edhu aagala-nu note pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Magnet attract pannura rendu objects sollunga. Wood-um plastic-um magnet-kitta attract aaguma?

teaching_sequence.title: Magnetic materials matrum poles
teaching_sequence.caption: Iron, nickel, cobalt madhiri sila materials magnetic properties kaattum. Bar magnet-oda rendu ends-la magnetic effect adhigama irukkum; andha ends north pole, south pole-nu solluvom. Middle portion-la attraction comparatively kammi.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Iron filings magnet-oda end pakkam adhigama gather aaguradhai diagram-la paarunga. Magnet-oda poles ends-la irukkum-nu idhu kaattudhu.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Bar magnet-la magnetic effect adhigama irukkura parts edhu? Andha rendu ends-ku enna peyar?

teaching_sequence.title: Freely suspended magnet
teaching_sequence.caption: Magnet-ai thread-la freely suspend panninaa, adhu settle aagumbodhu approximately north-south direction-la align aagum. North pakkam point pannura end north-seeking pole; opposite end south pole.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Magnet-ai thread-la suspend panni, adhu swing mudinju rest aagura direction-ai observe pannunga. Idhu Earth-oda magnetic field-oda interaction nala nadakkudhu.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Freely suspended magnet endha direction-la rest aagum? North-seeking pole-na enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Magnetic compass
teaching_sequence.caption: Compass-kulla small magnetised needle irukkum. Needle freely turn aagum; adhan north-seeking end north direction-ai kaattum. Map-la direction identify panna compass use pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Compass-ai flat surface-la vechu needle settle aagattum. N end north-ai point pannum. Nearby magnet vechaa needle deflect aagalam; adhanaala careful-aa use pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Compass needle-la north direction-ai kaattura end edhu? Nearby magnet irundhaa enna nadakkalaam?

teaching_sequence.title: Attraction matrum repulsion
teaching_sequence.caption: Rendu magnets-oda same poles (N-N alladhu S-S) pakkathula kondu vandhaa repel pannum. Opposite poles (N-S) attract pannum. Idhu magnets-oda mukkiya rule.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru magnet-oda N pole-ai innoru magnet-oda N pole-kitta kondu poi observe pannunga; appuram N-S try pannunga. Push/pull difference-ai compare pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Like poles enna pannum? Unlike poles enna pannum? N-S arrangement-la enna nadakkum?

teaching_sequence.title: Compass needle-um magnetic interaction-um
teaching_sequence.caption: Compass needle-um oru small magnet-thaan. Adhan pakkathula vera magnet kondu vandhaa needle direction maarum. Deflection-ai observe pannina pole interaction-ai identify panna mudiyum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Compass-ai stable-aa vechu, bar magnet-ai slow-aa pakkathula kondu vaanga. Needle eppadi turn aagudhu-nu paarunga. Magnet distance-um pole direction-um result-ai affect pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Compass needle yen deflect aagudhu? Magnet-ai move pannumbodhu needle direction eppadi change aagudhu?

teaching_sequence.title: Magnets recap matrum uses
teaching_sequence.caption: Magnets direction finding, toys, closures, speakers, magnetic separation madhiri pala places-la use aagudhu. Magnet-ai heat, hammer, drop repeated-aa panninaa strength kuraiyalaam. Magnet-ai safe-aa store pannunga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Namma lesson-la attraction, repulsion, poles, compass ellam connect pannuvom. Veettil alladhu school-la magnet use aagura oru example identify pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Magnet-oda oru use sollunga. Magnet strength damage aagama irukka enna care edukkanum?
